title: "File Search" in Command Palette: Doesn't filter results to folders when the "Folders" filter is selected

judgment.rationale: The report provides a version, filter sequence, and localized folder example. A controlled search can separate result filtering from indexing and localized name matching.
evidence: The report shows no folder result for either the Norwegian or English spelling.
The reported PowerToys version is 0.102.3101 on Norwegian Windows with English CmdPal.
judgment.recommended_action: Compare the same indexed folder and file under the combined and Folders filters before changing the query.

issue_context.summary: CmdPal File Search does not return the reported folder in Folders mode when searched by either its Norwegian display name or English name.
known_information: The issue provides screenshots of no matches and includes a diagnostic report.
The reported Windows display language is Norwegian and the CmdPal display language is English.
inferences: The absence of results could reflect the index scope, localization, or the Folders filter. The report alone does not distinguish these cases.
issue_context.analysis: First confirm that Windows Search indexes a uniquely named control folder and that CmdPal can find it with Files and folders selected. Then switch only the filter. If the control works but the localized folder still fails, compare its actual name and displayed name without assuming they are equivalent.
initial_investigation: Checked the public report and searched for a PR referencing this issue; no covering PR was found. No runtime reproduction has been performed.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code change is premature until the indexed control distinguishes the filter from index scope or localized name matching.

actions.label: Compare indexed folder results across File Search filters

prerequisites: Use a test profile on Norwegian Windows with CmdPal in English.
Use a test location that is indexed by Windows Search.
steps: Create a folder and a file with the same unique search term in their names. Confirm both appear in Windows Search.
In CmdPal File Search, search for the term under Files and folders, then switch to Folders without changing the query. Record which results remain.
Repeat for a known indexed folder with a localized display name, comparing its displayed and on-disk names under both filters.
reproduce.expected_result: The indexed control folder appears in both modes and the file is excluded in Folders mode. Any localized-name discrepancy is reproducible independently of the filter.
